scope: Original articulated clips and persistent dead poses, visually inspected in actual 1920x1080 action captures and 1280x720 idle/corpse captures. Not whole-game release readiness or Windows GPU certification.

failures: pose expired before live capture: move_path_step

observations: All 160 idle pairs and unobscured dead poses visually inspected; 480 small-screen captures.
Five chronological movement samples, melee, guard, dying, settled casualty context and ranged actions where applicable inspected for all 160 identities.
A living survivor may partly cover a corpse on a freed cell; isolated corpse captures confirm the correct dead artwork.

Original rendered run completed all160 and 27107 checks with one late movement screenshot:767ms after a700ms event. It remains failed. An unchanged focused Milestone Bucklers replay passed311 checks and replacement captures were inspected.
